The single narrowing backend is checked and pushed on formalize at 0da9b08b4bd08153112365e1550f82e81232130c. The configured API uses five rfl equations. Both recursive paths pass the same narrowing operation; there is no second enumeration worker. All 305 old theorem headers in the 48 changed files remain exact. Full build and strict Audit pass, including axiom dependencies for 95,263 imported project theorems. Audit has 4,913 direct imports (4,912 project imports plus Lean); those are separate counts. The three known totality modules outside Audit also build and strictly check. Only standard Lean axioms occur.

Two private identity laws also pass strict checking. They retain the same actual pending read, handle and heap. The non-repeated prefix law retains original queries, literal caller advance and exact Empty/nonempty observations for every native/representative/index/callback fuel. Read and false-check observations remain fixed hypotheses. The laws are not public yet. Next: publish them without changing their statements, then connect actual default entry, recursion and common bounds. Deep metadata erasure and full default-Haskell correspondence remain open.

The central missing result remains one finite accepted term of the same original root, with one jointly consistent assignment completing the same emitted partial root. Keep all other full-goal obligations. No Haskell/Cabal/test source changed or new Haskell fix was established. Proposed Liquid Haskell implementation contracts must use matching finite-completion semantics and checked implementation bodies; no such contract was verified here. The new restart packet is about 1 MiB of source, patches, scripts and logs, without compiled archives. Filesystem free space is about 102 GiB.
content.title: Single narrowing backend audited; exact identity prefix checked privately
